items.content: Research 最近更新 2026-07-15 教育与方向 项目与研究笔记 经历与联系 公开版 CV 本页仅保留公开联系方式；完整版简历可邮件索取。 教育背景 爱丁堡大学数学本科 2025–2026 于康奈尔大学完成交流学习 Expected graduation: 2027 研究方向 优化理论、形式化验证与数学建模。近期兴趣集中在一阶优化方法的机器检查证明、子模优化的近似保证，以及非凸极小极大问题中的 value-function 视角与二阶追踪问题。 代表项目与研究笔记 Isabelle/HOL：子模贪心算法形式化 正式发表于 AFP（2026）：对基数约束下的单调子模最大化，形式化 classical greedy algorithm 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy variant。发表后扩展：当前仓库还进一步发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 。 First-Order Optimization in Isabelle/HOL 对象：光滑凸优化中的投影梯度下降、一阶最优性条件与收敛性证明。结果：在 Isabelle/HOL 中整理投影几何、telescoping argument 与相关收敛结构，为后续优化算法形式化提供可复用组件。 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking 对象：非凸-强凹极小极大问题中的 two-timescale GDA、value function 与 Schur-complement Hessian。结果：整理一份探索性研究笔记，讨论从一阶追踪扩展到二阶曲率追踪与逃逸机制时可能出现的问题。 Duality and Lower Bounds under Invariances 对象：带图相对结构的优化目标。结果：分析平移不变性与不可识别性如何导致自然下界退化，并探索 gauge-fixing、增广等结构修正方案。 专利与 IP Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device —— 发明专利在审 Anti-Segregation Spreading Device —— 实用新型已于 2025-07-04 授权 公开页面不展示专利号。 研究经历 独立研究 —— 优化 康奈尔大学运筹学与信息工程学院（ORIE） 指导老师：Prof. Shoham Sabach 2026–至今 研究带图相对结构目标中的对偶与下界问题。 分析平移不变性 / 不可识别性如何导致自然下界退化。 推进 gauge-fixing、增广等结构修正方案。 独立研究 —— 面向优化的形式化方法 爱丁堡大学信息学院 指导老师：Dr. Wenda Li 2025–2026 完成子模函数与贪心算法近似保证的 Isabelle/HOL formal proof development，并以 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 正式发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs。 继续整理投影梯度下降与一阶优化方法相关的证明组件与形式化结构。 其他经历 数据分析 负责转化漏斗、留存与归因分析，并排查归因与映射逻辑中的问题，使后续汇报口径更一致、结果更可解释。 建模与工程分析 参与砂石相关系统在实际约束下的建模与分析，包括参数调整，以及与实验方案相关的协同工作。 Selected Evidence AFP entry · DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 · Proof document · Isabelle/HOL formalization repo · PGD formalization note · TTGDA exploratory note 联系方式 Fay / Feier Lyu Email: moc.duolci@035reief Location: currently between Chongqing, Edinburgh, and Ithaca Available by email Public CV This page lists public contact information only; a fuller CV is available on request by email. Education BSc Mathematics, University of Edinburgh Completed exchange study at Cornell University, 2025–2026 Expected graduation: 2027 Research Directions Optimization theory, formal verification, and mathematical modeling. Recent interests center on machine-checked proofs for first-order optimization methods, approximation guarantees for submodular optimization, and the value-function viewpoint and second-order tracking questions in nonconvex minimax problems. Selected Projects and Research Notes Isabelle/HOL: Formalizing Submodular Greedy Published in AFP (2026): a formalization of the classical greedy algorithm and a verified stateful lazy-greedy variant for cardinality-constrained monotone submodular maximization. Post-publication extension: the current repository additionally develops a stochastic-greedy line, including sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting. DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21054718 . First-Order Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Object: projected gradient descent, first-order optimality conditions, and convergence proofs in smooth convex optimization. Result: organized projection geometry, telescoping arguments, and convergence structures in Isabelle/HOL as reusable components for later optimization-algorithm formalization; submitted to the Archive of Formal Proofs and awaiting review. TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Object: two-timescale GDA, value functions, and the Schur-complement Hessian in nonconvex-strongly-concave minimax problems. Result: prepared an exploratory research note on possible issues when extending first-order tracking to second-order curvature tracking and escape mechanisms. Duality and Lower Bounds under Invariances Object: optimization objectives with graph-relative structure. Result: analyzed how translation invariance and non-identifiability make natural lower bounds degenerate, and explored structural fixes such as gauge-fixing and augmentation. Patents and IP Anti-Segregation Spreading Method and Device — invention patent under review Anti-Segregation Spreading Device — utility model granted on 2025-07-04 Patent numbers are omitted on this public page. Research Experience Independent Research — Optimization Cornell University, School of Operations Research and Information Engineering (ORIE) Under the guidance of Prof. Shoham Sabach 2026–present Research on duality and lower bounds for graph-relative optimization objectives. Study of how translation invariance and non-identifiability lead natural lower bounds to collapse. Current work on structural fixes such as gauge-fixing and augmentation. Independent Research — Formal Methods for Optimization University of Edinburgh, School of Informatics Under the guidance of Dr. Wenda Li 2025–2026 Completed the Isabelle/HOL formal proof development of approximation guarantees for submodular greedy algorithms, published in the Archive of Formal Proofs as Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization. Completed and submitted the formalization of projected gradient descent and first-order optimization methods to the Archive of Formal Proofs; awaiting review. Other Experience Data Analytics Worked on funnel, retention, and attribution analysis, and helped diagnose attribution and mapping issues so that downstream reporting became more consistent and interpretable. Modeling and Engineering Analysis Worked on modeling and analysis for aggregate-related systems under practical constraints, including parameter tuning and coordination with experimental considerations.
